description: This file defines the class 'ColumnLeft' which extends the base Controller class in the 'Common' namespace of the OpenCart Catalog module. It generates the HTML for the left column menu in the admin interface, including loading modules and their configurations based on the current route and layout, and assembling the view for the column.

classes.name: ColumnLeft
classes.description: Controller class for rendering the 'Column Left' menu in the admin interface, dynamically loading modules and setting up view data based on current route and layout.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates the HTML for the left column menu by loading modules, determining the layout ID, and rendering the 'common/column_left' view with prepared data.
